content.overview: Sections 241 and 242 allow members who meet the threshold to apply to the Tribunal for relief against oppression or mismanagement.
content.glance: Sections 241 and 242 allow members who meet the threshold to apply to the Tribunal for relief against oppression or mismanagement.
content.study: Application lies where affairs are conducted in a manner prejudicial to public interest, or oppressive to the member or prejudicial to the company, or a material change is likely to cause that result. The numerical threshold is one hundred members or one-tenth of members, or members holding one-tenth of issued share capital; the Tribunal may waive it. Relief under s. 242 can regulate conduct, set aside transactions, remove directors, or provide for purchase of shares. A mere loss of confidence is not enough. Class action is the separate s. 245 route.
